versions.content: Types of OsTaskProxy There are different ways to use an OsTaskProxy : • Purely in the context of a SwComponentType . This is called AppTaskProxy . An OsTaskProxy is an AppTaskProxy , if it is only referenced by RteEventIn- CompositionToOsTaskProxyMapping s (in the role osTaskProxy ), and NOT referenced by any EcuInstance (in the role ecuTaskProxy ). This prop- erty can (optionally) be declared by setting the OsTaskProxy ’s category to APP_TASK_PROXY . • Purely in the context of an EcuInstance . This is called EcuTaskProxy . An OsTaskProxy is an EcuTaskProxy , if it is only referenced by an EcuInstance (in the role ecuTaskProxy ), and NOT referenced by any RteEventInCompo- sitionToOsTaskProxyMapping (in the role osTaskProxy ). This property can (optionally) be declared by setting the OsTaskProxy ’s category to ECU_ TASK_PROXY . • Both in context of a SwComponentType and an EcuInstance . This is called AppAndEcuTaskProxy . An OsTaskProxy is an AppAndEcuTaskProxy , if it is referenced to by an EcuInstance (in the role ecuTaskProxy ), AND refer- enced by at leat one RteEventInCompositionToOsTaskProxyMapping (in the role osTaskProxy ). This property can (optionally) be declared by setting the OsTaskProxy ’s category to APP_AND_ECU_TASK_PROXY .
